reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and response handling, and shares link validation and local unlinking across providers.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of the account-linking workflow and an almost identical copy of the Akahu transaction downloader.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, server configuration and provider types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The changes address the four requested steps, with supporting tests, provider registration and minimal client type accommodations.

maintainability.why: Centralized rules help maintenance, but duplicated provider workflows and an assertion helper that also unlinks accounts obscure responsibilities.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers call assertBankAccountCanBeLinked, and both replacement and explicit unlinking use clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount reproduces the existing linking workflow with provider substitutions, while downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces downloadAkahuTransactions with renamed provider references and reshaped local declarations.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountCanBeLinked gains replaceExistingLink, nested upgradingId/closed checks and an existing-holder clearing branch, evolving from validation into mutation orchestration.
